product.description: Un apel urgent după ajutor îl aduce pe Poirot în Franța. Însă acesta ajunge prea târziu pentru a-și salva clientul, al cărui trup înjunghiat cu brutalitate zace cu fața în jos într-un mormânt săpat pe terenul de golf. Dar de ce poartă mortul un palton prea mare pentru el? Și pentru cine era scrisoarea pasională din buzunarul lui? Înainte ca Poirot să răspundă la aceste întrebări, cazul este dat peste cap în urma descoperirii unui al doilea cadavru...

# Crime on the Golf Course: A Gripping Murder Mystery by Litera

Dive into a classic puzzle of suspense with this compelling detective novel. In *Crime on the Golf Course*, renowned detective Poirot is called upon for an urgent appeal in France. But the arrival comes too late, setting the stage for a complex and deeply intriguing investigation into one of the most baffling mysteries modern literature has seen.

## ðª Synopsis: The Mystery Unfolds

The story begins with a shocking discovery: a clientâs body, brutally stabbed and found face down within a freshly dug grave on an exclusive golf course. Poirot is immediately faced with questions that defy logic. Why is the deceased wearing a coat that appears far too large for his frame? And who was the owner of the passionate, incriminating letter discovered in his pocket?

As Poirot attempts to piece together these baffling clues, the mystery deepens rapidly. Before he can even begin to answer these central questions, the case spirals out of control with the shocking discovery of a second body. This book masterfully weaves together elements of classic crime fiction, forcing readers to solve the puzzle alongside Poirot as secrets and sinister motives surface across the lush green grounds of the golf course.

## Why Read Crime on the Golf Course?

This novel delivers the perfect blend of atmospheric suspense and intellectual challenge. If you enjoy intricate plotting, beloved characters like Hercule Poirot, and gripping murder mystery narratives, this book is essential reading. It offers a thrilling journey into the heart of Parisian high society and the dark secrets hidden beneath a seemingly peaceful outdoor landscape.
